Brief review 2026-09-18 (Motorcycle Cover creative hub) — this brief has an error the editor must know about:
1. `30 dagars öppet köp – gillar du inte kapellet får du pengarna tillbaka.` and the CTA `349 kr – beställ med öppet köp.` — the product page says `Du har 14 dagars ångerrätt enligt lag` and never mentions 30 days (read live from the product page 2026-09-21); free shipping within Sweden, 5–10 working days and Klarna are true (site banner). Fix before this goes live: real terms only (`Fri frakt inom Sverige`, `Leverans på 5–10 arbetsdagar`, `14 dagars ångerrätt enligt lag`).
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.

varningar: no product folder in the repo (products.json / register.json) — dna.md and feedback.md do not apply; the Feedback row in the hub is the memory
